title: Sonata No. 4 in C minor for violin and harpsichord
movement: I. Largo (Siciliano) (render_midi); three further movements in the score files
video_use_ideas: Aching siciliano melody for an emotional story beat.
legal_notes: Composition PD worldwide (J. S. Bach d.1750). Mutopia piece 1733 ('Sonata for Violin and Clavier No.4', for Violin & Clavier); licence shown as Public Domain on the piece page, in the Mutopia RDF and in the .ly header (placed in the public domain by typesetter Ryan Prince). Edition source: Leipzig: Breitkopf & Härtel, (1860). Plate B.W.IX. Preview is an own FluidSynth (FluidR3_GM) render of the Mutopia MIDI, not a human performance; no recording in this row.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
